f.title: No obligation to distribute aRMM materials for products not marketed in Estonia
f.statement: The MAH has no obligation to distribute additional risk minimisation materials for products that are not marketed in Estonia.
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Local PV interfaces

rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder has no obligation to distribute materials for medicinal products that are not marketed in Estonia.

f.title: Submit and agree aRMM materials before marketing starts; market only if aRMM conditions are met
f.statement: Additional risk minimisation materials must be submitted to and agreed with Ravimiamet before marketing starts. Compliance with risk minimisation measures is a condition of the marketing authorisation, so the product may be marketed only when the conditions on existence, content and distribution of the materials are fulfilled.
f.applicability: aRMM materials that are part of the MA (Annex II D or approved RMP)
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Local PV interfaces

rows.quote: Materjalid tuleb esitada ja kooskõlastada enne turustamise alustamist. Riski minimeerimise meetmete järgimine on müügiloa tingimus, mis tähendab seda, et ravimit tohib turustada vaid juhul, kui tingimused on täidetud (materjalide olemasolu, sisu ja levitamise osas).

rows.quote_en: The materials must be submitted and agreed before marketing begins. Compliance with the risk minimisation measures is a condition of the marketing authorisation, which means that the medicinal product may be marketed only if the conditions are fulfilled (as regards the existence, content and distribution of the materials).

f.title: Update the RMP via a variation before using own-initiative aRMM materials
f.statement: If the MAH on its own initiative considers additional risk minimisation measures necessary that include materials for healthcare professionals or patients, it must first update the risk management plan and submit a variation application. Only after the variation is approved are the materials part of the marketing authorisation; materials produced on own initiative are otherwise treated as advertising and not reviewed by Ravimiamet.

rows.quote: Juhul kui müügiloa hoidja peab omaalgatuslikult vajalikuks rakendada ravimi ohutuse tagamiseks riski minimeerimise lisameetmeid, mis hõlmavad ka materjale tervishoiutöötajatele või ravimi kasutajatele, tuleb eelnevalt täiendada riskijuhtimise kava ja esitada vastav muutuse taotlus. Alles pärast muutuse kinnitamist saab neid materjale lugeda müügiloa osaks.

rows.quote_en: If the marketing authorisation holder on its own initiative considers it necessary to implement additional risk minimisation measures to ensure the safety of the medicinal product, which also include materials for healthcare professionals or users of the medicinal product, the risk management plan must first be supplemented and a corresponding variation application submitted. Only after the variation has been approved can these materials be regarded as part of the marketing authorisation.

f.title: Prepare, submit and distribute aRMM materials in line with GVP XVI Addendum I
f.statement: Preparation, submission and distribution of the materials must comply with GVP Module XVI Addendum I (Educational materials).

f.title: Submit final English source materials and Estonian translations as .docx before distribution
f.statement: Before distributing additional risk minimisation materials to healthcare professionals or users, the MAH is obliged (Medicinal Products Act s.78^5(9)) to submit to Ravimiamet the final English source materials and the Estonian translations as .docx files, by e-mail to the Ravimiamet pharmacovigilance mailbox.

rows.quote: Müügiloa hoidja on enne tervishoiutöötajatele või ravimi kasutajatele täiendavate riski minimeerimise lisameetmena ettenähtud materjalide levitamist kohustatud (alus: Ravimiseadus § 785 lõige 9) esitama Ravimiametile ingliskeelsed lõplikud alusmaterjalid ja eestikeelsed tõlked *.docx failina.

f.title: State product, substance, "aRMM" and first/repeat submission in the e-mail subject and explain the reason
f.statement: For quick handling, the e-mail subject must state the product name, active substance(s), "aRMM" and "first" or "repeat" submission; the letter must explain the reason for sending (MA condition - Annex II D, or RMP requirement); for repeat materials it must explain when the previous materials were approved, what the changes derive from and the main changes, with tracked changes in the Estonian file.

f.title: Explain previous approval and main changes for repeat materials, with tracked changes
f.statement: For repeat materials, the MAH must explain when the materials were last approved, what the changes derive from and what the main changes are; changes must be made traceably in the Estonian file.

f.title: Always submit an Estonia-specific communication plan
f.statement: A communication plan adapted to Estonia must always be submitted, stating: to whom the materials are addressed (for HCP materials the specialty, and names where individual doctors); how they are distributed (by name to doctors, via specialist societies, hospital departments, hospital pharmacies, etc.; by direct contact, e-mail or post); and when (planned date; for repeat materials, how withdrawal or destruction of the previous version is ensured).

f.title: Provide details of an Estonian-speaking PV contact person in Estonia with aRMM oversight
f.statement: The MAH must always provide the details of its Estonian-speaking pharmacovigilance contact person in Estonia (Minister of Social Affairs Regulation No 26 s.4(4)). Ravimiamet expects this person to have an overview of the implementation of the additional risk minimisation measures (content, target group, training), to ensure the information reaches the target group and to be able to answer questions from healthcare professionals and Ravimiamet. The named contact is for Ravimiamet, not for printing on the materials.
f.legal_basis: Minister of Social Affairs Regulation No 26 § 4(4)
f.processes: Local PV interfaces; Risk management & minimisation

f.title: Ensure every target healthcare professional receives the aRMM materials or completes the training
f.statement: The MAH must ensure that every healthcare professional in the target group receives the additional risk minimisation materials or completes the training.

rows.quote: Müügiloa hoidja kohustus on tagada, et iga sihtgrupi tervishoiutöötaja saab riski minimeerimise lisameetmena ettenähtud materjalid / läbib koolituse.

rows.quote_en: It is the obligation of the marketing authorisation holder to ensure that every healthcare professional in the target group receives the materials intended as additional risk minimisation measures / completes the training.

f.title: Distribute materials by name to HCPs or through specialist societies with hospital departments or pharmacies
f.statement: The MAH sends the materials to healthcare professionals by name, or to specialist societies together with the relevant hospital departments and/or hospital pharmacies.

rows.quote: Müügiloa hoidja edastab materjalid tervishoiutöötajatele nimeliselt või erialaseltsidele koos haiglate vastavate osakondadega ja/või haiglaapteekidega.

f.title: Require confirmation from the specialist society and re-contact it if none within 1 week
f.statement: When the MAH sends materials to the target group by e-mail via a specialist society, the cover letter must clearly require the society to confirm to the MAH that the materials were forwarded to its members. If no confirmation is received within 1 week, the MAH must contact the society or target group once more.

rows.deadline: Re-contact if no confirmation within 1 week

If no confirmation is received within 1 week, the marketing authorisation holder must contact the relevant specialist society/target group once more.

f.title: Inform Ravimiamet if a society does not reply within 1 week after the reminder and agree another delivery route
f.statement: If no reply is received within 1 week after the reminder, the MAH must inform Ravimiamet and, together with Ravimiamet, decide how to deliver the materials in another way.
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Local PV interfaces

rows.deadline: After 1 week without reply following the reminder

f.title: Keep records of who received the materials or completed training and when
f.statement: The MAH must keep records for the target group in the communication plan of who received the materials or completed the training, and when.
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Data integrity & records

rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder must keep records on the target group set out in the communication plan (to whom the materials have been sent / who has completed the training and when).

f.title: Ravimiamet may distribute materials, and English materials may be used, by agreement
f.statement: In certain cases Ravimiamet may distribute the materials by agreement with the MAH. By agreement with Ravimiamet, English-language materials may exceptionally be distributed (for example few users, or materials not intended for patients).

f.title: Repeat distribution follows the approved communication plan without resubmission
f.statement: Repeat distribution (re-sending the currently approved versions to the target group or society) follows the previously approved communication plan, which is linked to a specific material version; the plan need not be resubmitted for re-approval.

rows.quote: Materjalide korduv levitamine toimub vastavalt eelnevalt kinnitatud kommunikatsiooniplaanile. Kommunikatsiooniplaan on alati seotud konkreetse haridusmaterjali versiooniga. Korduval levitamisel ei ole vaja kommunikatsiooniplaani Ravimiametile taaskinnitamiseks esitada.

rows.quote_en: Repeat distribution of the materials takes place in accordance with the previously approved communication plan. The communication plan is always linked to a specific version of the educational material. For repeat distribution it is not necessary to submit the communication plan to the State Agency of Medicines for re-approval.

f.title: Notify Ravimiamet of new target HCPs and send them the materials outside the schedule
f.statement: If healthcare professionals not listed in the approved communication plan join the target group, the MAH sends Ravimiamet their list for information by e-mail (no approval needed) and distributes the materials to them outside the approved schedule; at the next regular repeat distribution all members of the expanded target group receive the materials.
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Local PV interfaces

rows.quote: Kui sihtgruppi on lisandunud tervishoiutöötajaid, keda ei ole varem kinnitatud kommunikatsiooniplaanis kirjas, esitab müügiloa hoidja Ravimiametile teadmiseks nende nimekirja e-maili teel ja jagab uutele tervishoiutöötajatele materjalid väljapool kommunikatsiooniplaanis kinnitatud haridusmaterjalide levitamise graafikut. Nimekiri ei vaja Ravimiameti kinnitust.

rows.quote_en: If healthcare professionals who were not previously listed in the approved communication plan have joined the target group, the marketing authorisation holder submits their list to the State Agency of Medicines for information by e-mail and distributes the materials to the new healthcare professionals outside the distribution schedule for educational materials approved in the communication plan. The list does not require approval by the State Agency of Medicines.

f.title: Keep promotional elements out of aRMM materials; MAH logo only once with contacts
f.statement: Materials must not contain promotional elements (product logo, irrelevant images). The MAH logo may appear once, next to the MAH contact details.

rows.quote: Materjalid ei tohi sisaldada reklaamielemente (ravimi logo, asjasse mittepuutuvad pildid). Müügiloa hoidja logo võib materjalides olla esitatud ühe korra müügiloa hoidja kontaktide juures.

rows.quote_en: When distributing a changed version of the materials, the healthcare professional must be reminded that the previous version is obsolete and asked to destroy it.

f.title: Distribute materials at the RMP/Annex II D frequency, or on update or request
f.statement: The distribution frequency stated in the RMP or Annex II D must be followed. If no frequency is stated, materials must be distributed when updated/changed or when Ravimiamet requires.

rows.quote: Materjalide levitamise sagedus – järgida tuleb levitamise sagedust, mis on toodud riskijuhtimiskavas või müügiloa Lisas II D. Kui levitamise sagedust ei ole toodud, tuleb materjale levitada nende uuendamisel / muutmisel või Ravimiameti nõudmisel.

Bilingual check: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en; "tuleb/peab/peavad/on kohustatud" = must (Mandatory), "võib" = may (Permitted), "tuleks" = should (Recommended). Review: OK. rows.quote_en: Frequency of distribution of the materials – the distribution frequency set out in the risk management plan or in Annex II D of the marketing authorisation must be followed. If no distribution frequency is given, the materials must be distributed when they are updated / changed or at the request of the State Agency of Medicines.

f.title: For video aRMM submit the English video and an Estonian script for review
f.statement: Where the risk minimisation measure is a video, the English video and a written Estonian script must be submitted for review; after approval the video is linked in the medicines register from the MAH website or YouTube.

rows.quote: Videomaterjal – kui riskivähendamise meetmeks on video, siis tuleb üle vaatamiseks esitada ingliskeelne video ja kirjalik eestikeelne stsenaarium vajadusel täienduste/muudatuste tegemiseks.
rows.review_note: National (Estonia) Ravimiamet guidance on additional risk minimisation materials (national implementation of GVP XVI Add I and Medicinal Products Act s.78^5(9)); marked national. Bilingual check: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en; "tuleb/peab/peavad/on kohustatud" = must (Mandatory), "võib" = may (Permitted), "tuleks" = should (Recommended). Review: OK. Double-check: OK.
rows.quote_en: Video material – if the risk minimisation measure is a video, the English-language video and a written Estonian script must be submitted for review so that supplements/changes can be made if necessary.

f.title: Make audio aRMM for visually impaired patients match the approved patient material
f.statement: Where the measure is an audio file presenting patient material to visually impaired patients, its content must correspond to the approved patient material.

rows.quote: Audiomaterjal - kui riskivähendamise meetmeks on audiofail, mis on mõeldud patsiendi materjali esitamiseks nägemispuudega patsiendile, siis peab see sisult vastama kinnitatud patsiendi materjalile.
rows.review_note: National (Estonia) Ravimiamet guidance on additional risk minimisation materials (national implementation of GVP XVI Add I and Medicinal Products Act s.78^5(9)); marked national. Bilingual check: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en; "tuleb/peab/peavad/on kohustatud" = must (Mandatory), "võib" = may (Permitted), "tuleks" = should (Recommended). Review: OK. Double-check: OK.
rows.quote_en: Audio material - if the risk minimisation measure is an audio file intended to present patient material to a visually impaired patient, its content must correspond to the approved patient material.

f.title: Submit the in-pack patient alert card as PDF before marketing in Estonia
f.statement: A patient alert card that is part of the product information and included in the package must be submitted to Ravimiamet as a PDF before marketing starts in Estonia. Where marketing in a foreign-language package containing a patient card is permitted, inclusion or distribution of the card must be agreed with Ravimiamet beforehand.

rows.quote: Patsiendi ohutuskaart, mis on ravimiinfo osa ning mis lisatakse pakendisse, tuleb esitada pdf failina Ravimiametile enne ravimi turustamise algust Eestis. Ravimiamet lisab patsiendi ohutuskaardi pdf faili ravimiregistrisse. Kui antakse luba turustada võõrkeelses pakendis ravimit, millel on pakendis patsiendi ohutuskaart, tuleb eelnevalt Ravimiametiga kokku leppida patsiendi ohutuskaardi lisamine pakendisse/levitamine.
rows.review_note: National (Estonia) Ravimiamet guidance on additional risk minimisation materials (national implementation of GVP XVI Add I and Medicinal Products Act s.78^5(9)); marked national. Bilingual check: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en; "tuleb/peab/peavad/on kohustatud" = must (Mandatory), "võib" = may (Permitted), "tuleks" = should (Recommended). Review: OK. Double-check: OK.
rows.quote_en: The patient alert card, which is part of the product information and is included in the package, must be submitted to the State Agency of Medicines as a pdf file before marketing of the medicinal product begins in Estonia. The State Agency of Medicines adds the pdf file of the patient alert card to the medicines register. If permission is given to market a medicinal product in a foreign-language package containing a patient alert card, the inclusion in the package/distribution of the patient alert card must be agreed with the State Agency of Medicines in advance.

f.title: Publish educational materials on an MAH website only by agreement and submit the web address
f.statement: Educational materials may be published on a separate MAH-created website by agreement with Ravimiamet; the website information must be consistent with the approved material and the web address must be submitted to Ravimiamet.

rows.quote: Õppematerjalide avaldamine müügiloa hoidja eraldi loodud veebilehel – kokkuleppel Ravimiametiga. Veebilehe teave on kooskõlas varem Ravimiameti poolt heakskiidetud õppematerjaliga. Ravimiametile tuleb esitada veebilehe aadress.
rows.review_note: National (Estonia) Ravimiamet guidance on additional risk minimisation materials (national implementation of GVP XVI Add I and Medicinal Products Act s.78^5(9)); marked national. Bilingual check: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en; "tuleb/peab/peavad/on kohustatud" = must (Mandatory), "võib" = may (Permitted), "tuleks" = should (Recommended). Review: OK. Double-check: OK.
rows.quote_en: Publication of educational materials on a separate website created by the marketing authorisation holder – by agreement with the State Agency of Medicines. The information on the website is consistent with the educational material previously approved by the State Agency of Medicines. The address of the website must be submitted to the State Agency of Medicines.

f.title: Show the black triangle and the additional monitoring statement on aRMM materials
f.statement: If the product is on the additional monitoring list, the warning must also appear on the materials required as additional risk minimisation: the black triangle on the cover/front page and the explanatory statement in the footer (Estonian wording given in the guidance).
f.applicability: Products on the EU additional monitoring list

f.title: Give HCPs a generic MAH phone and e-mail contact with answers in Estonian
f.statement: In materials for healthcare professionals, contact details (for ordering materials or reporting adverse reactions) must be the MAH's (local representative's) telephone and e-mail, not a named person or named e-mail address; the healthcare professional must receive a reply in Estonian.
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Local PV interfaces

rows.quote: Tervishoiutöötaja peab saama vastuse oma pöördumisele eesti keeles. Kontaktandmed tervishoiutöötajale suunatud materjalis peavad olema esitatud müügiloa hoidja (kohaliku esinduse vms) telefoni ja meiliaadressina, kuid mitte nimelise kontaktina, sh mitte nimelise meiliaadressina.

rows.quote_en: The healthcare professional must receive a reply to their enquiry in Estonian. The contact details in material addressed to healthcare professionals must be given as the telephone number and e-mail address of the marketing authorisation holder (local representation or similar), but not as a named contact, including not as a named e-mail address.

f.title: In patient materials advise talking to the doctor and use the PIL MAH details
f.statement: Patient materials must advise the patient to talk to their doctor for more information; MAH details in patient materials must be the same as in the package leaflet.

rows.quote: Patsiendile suunatud materjalides tuleb lisateabe saamiseks anda patsiendile soovitus rääkida oma arstiga. Müügiloa hoidja andmed patsiendile suunatud materjalis peavad olema samad, mis pakendi infolehes.
rows.review_note: National (Estonia) Ravimiamet guidance on additional risk minimisation materials (national implementation of GVP XVI Add I and Medicinal Products Act s.78^5(9)); marked national. Bilingual check: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en; "tuleb/peab/peavad/on kohustatud" = must (Mandatory), "võib" = may (Permitted), "tuleks" = should (Recommended). Review: under "Recommendations" heading with "tuleb/peavad" (must). Double-check: kept below 90.
rows.quote_en: In materials addressed to patients, the patient must be advised to talk to their doctor for further information. The marketing authorisation holder's details in material addressed to patients must be the same as in the package leaflet.

f.title: Copy Ravimiamet when distributing materials electronically via a specialist society
f.statement: When forwarding materials to the target group electronically via a specialist society, the MAH should add the Ravimiamet pharmacovigilance mailbox as a recipient; cover letter templates are in Annexes 1 and 2.

f.title: Use the cover letter templates and state what changed versus the previous version
f.statement: Cover letters to specialist societies or doctors follow the templates in Annexes 1 and 2; for updated material the letter should briefly state what has changed compared with the previous version, and the society letter asks for confirmation of forwarding.

rows.quote_en: In the case of updated material, what has changed compared with the previous version should be briefly pointed out.
